title: Simple Unit Test
question: Write a unittest case that checks addition.
code:
import unittest

class MathTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add(self):
        self.assertEqual(2 + 3, 5)

suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(MathTests)
result = unittest.TestResult()
suite.run(result)
print(result.testsRun, len(result.failures), len(result.errors))
explanation: unittest provides test cases and assertions for automated checks.
